ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: To throw a brick to draw out jade is to offer something deliberately lesser in hopes of eliciting something finer.
EvidenceBody: Hanxiu Ruqian and Langting Jingting retell Zhaozhou inviting questions as throwing a brick, only to draw out another clod. Shending Yikui praises an official's attempt to elicit jade but says he still missed his household treasure. Zhufeng Zhenxu applies the image to Shakyamuni eliciting Mahakasyapa, while Tianyin Yuanxiu accepts a layman's letter as a successful brick that reveals his capacity. Chan deployment therefore tests both halves of the tactic: what bait is offered and whether the response is actually jade.
